arg.name: x_min
arg.description: Forward distance (m) where binning starts -- skips the LiDAR near blind zone

arg.name: x_max
arg.description: Forward distance (m) where binning stops -- LiDAR range / mask reliability limit

arg.name: min_points_per_bin
arg.description: Density gate: bins with fewer painted points than this are skipped rather than extrapolated. This CARLA LiDAR config (64ch, 120deg camera FOV overlap) only yields ~30-40 shoulder-painted points/frame spread across the full x_min..x_max range, so a high threshold here starves every bin -- 15 was tuned for a denser sensor and left every bin empty in practice.

arg.name: min_valid_bins
arg.description: Minimum valid bins required before a centerline is fit/published at all

arg.name: z_min
arg.description: Ground-height band (base_link frame) -- rejects mask bleed onto guardrail/vegetation

arg.name: bin_source
arg.description: Where each bin's lateral sample comes from. 'mask_ipm' (default): dense per-image-row mask-boundary midpoint, back-projected to base_link via ground-plane IPM -- robust even on a narrow shoulder. 'lidar': sparse LiDAR points projected into the mask -- can be too sparse/noisy on a narrow shoulder. Set to 'lidar' to instantly revert (no rebuild).

arg.name: mask_row_step
arg.description: Sample every Nth image row for the mask_ipm method

arg.name: min_mask_run_px
arg.description: Minimum contiguous shoulder-classified pixel run width in a row to accept it (rejects single-pixel mask noise). Only used when bin_source=mask_ipm

arg.name: centerline_estimator
arg.description: How each bin's lateral center is computed: 'extent_midpoint' (default) takes the midpoint of the (trimmed) left/right edge of samples -- the standard lane-centerline technique; 'median' is the old density-weighted centroid, which was biased toward whichever edge got more samples. Set to 'median' to instantly revert (no rebuild) if extent_midpoint regresses.

arg.name: edge_trim_fraction
arg.description: Fraction trimmed off each end before taking the extent midpoint, to reject outlier points. Only used when centerline_estimator=extent_midpoint

arg.name: smoothing_alpha
arg.description: EMA factor for frame-to-frame lateral-offset smoothing; 1.0 = no smoothing

arg.name: accumulate_path
arg.description: Publish a second, persistent map-frame Path built from world-frame LiDAR-sample bins (median of every sample ever observed per bin), instead of only the local ego-relative window that RViz redraws from scratch every frame

arg.name: min_world_bin_samples
arg.description: Minimum accumulated raw-point samples (across ALL frames) a world bin needs before it appears in the published path. Higher = smoother (each real-world 1m segment is visible ~50-100+ times as the vehicle approaches, so this converges fast) but a longer lag behind the vehicle before that stretch appears

arg.name: max_accumulated_points
arg.description: Caps how many finalized world bins are retained/published (oldest dropped first)

arg.name: world_bin_near_margin
arg.description: Exclude the nearest N valid bins each frame from world-bin accumulation only (never the local path) -- at short range the mask_ipm ray is nearly vertical, so small mask-boundary noise there maps to a large swing in the back-projected point, producing a curve at the start of the local path that would otherwise get baked into the accumulated trail. Set to 0 to disable (no rebuild).
